subject: Request: brief platform review + timeline for case study
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: brief platform review + timeline for case study

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We really appreciate ClearSpring letting us run the pilot — your team's feedback has already helped us prioritize a couple of runtime improvements.

Quick ask: would you and a colleague be open to a 20-minute call next week to capture a short G2/Capterra review and a couple of quotes we can use in a one-page case study? We keep this very lightweight — two bullets on what worked, one sentence on impact.

We have a small thank-you: a $50 e-gift for each reviewer (Happy to confirm procurement requirements if needed). I attached a short "review-instructions.pdf" that explains the flow and what we ask for in the call.

Suggested slots: Tue 9/8 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 9/9 14:00-14:30 PT — if neither works tell me two windows that do and we'll lock it in.

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
David Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Email: david.kim@redwood.com | M: (415) 555-0132

Attachments: review-instructions.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

Sounds good — thanks for sending, David. Elena and I can do Tue 9/8 10:00 PT.

A few quick notes/questions:
- Can you confirm who will be on your side for the call? I see Marissa and Ben on cc; is someone from product joining?
- We need a short form for approvals on our side for any public quote. If you can share the case study draft in advance (even a bullet summary) that helps us route it quickly.
- On the e-gift: our procurement needs a vendor name and a simple invoice/fulfillment form. Is that something you can send so we can approve the incentive before the call?

Looking forward — please add the calendar invite and any prep doc.

Best,
Samantha
Head of Clinical Ops | ClearSpring Health

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Request: brief platform review + timeline for case study

Marissa / Ben —

Good news: Samantha and Elena confirmed Tue 9/8 10:00 PT. They asked for a case-study draft in advance and procurement paperwork for the gift card.

Ask list:
- Marissa: can you draft a one-page case study (bullet summary + 2 short quotes) and share by EOD Monday? We should include the pilot metrics (latency reduction / token cost delta) and one customer quote placeholder. Label it "ClearSpring draft - do not publish".
- Ben: can you generate the fulfillment form for procurement (simple vendor/amount/po line) and the internal giftcard process? We typically send an e-gift via Tango; procurement sometimes needs vendor EIN — see if legal has a short statement we can reuse.
- I'll add the calendar invite and include the review-instructions.pdf. Also I'll get a short consent checkbox language for the DocuSign link so they can approve the quote.

Target: have docs to them Mon 9/7 so procurement has time. If one of you can't hit that timeline, tell me now and I'll push the meeting.

Thanks — david

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 16KB)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@clearspring.io>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@clearspring.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: ClearSpring review Tue 9/8 10:00 PT + prep materials

Hi Samantha / Elena —

Thanks again for confirming the slot. Calendar invite is attached and the meeting link is here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=clearspring-g2-review-20260908.

Attached: case-study-draft.docx (redwood draft), giftcard-fulfillment-form.pdf (vendor info we collected). The case study is intentionally short — two bullets, one short quote placeholder for your legal/marketing to OK. If you want different wording, send redlines after the call and we'll update.

Gift card fulfillment: Ben & I will route the $50 e-gift after we receive the signed procurement acknowledgement. If procurement needs any additional vendor details I've included the DocuSign link to a short consent/quote approval: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123456789.

Agenda for the 20-min call:
1) Quick recap of pilot metrics (5 min)
2) Two prompt questions for a short review (7 min)
3) Confirm quote wording and publishing permissions (8 min)

If you'd like us to share the final case study with your comms lead before publishing, add them on the reply and we'll include them in the distribution.

Talk soon — David

Attachments: case-study-draft.docx (DOCX, 24KB), giftcard-fulfillment-form.pdf (PDF, 9KB)
